name: Norse Creatures
description: The Norse cosmos teems with legendary creatures - from the monstrous children of Loki destined to bring about Ragnarok, to divine steeds and guardian beasts.
longDescription:
The Norse cosmos teems with legendary creatures - from the monstrous children of Loki destined to bring about Ragnarok, to divine steeds and guardian beasts.

The monstrous wolf, son of Loki and the giantess Angrboda. Fenrir grew so large and fearsome that the gods bound him with the magical chain Gleipnir, but he will break free at Ragnarok and devour Odin himself.

The Midgard Serpent, another child of Loki. Odin threw Jormungandr into the ocean where the serpent grew so large it encircles the entire world and grasps its own tail.

Odin's magnificent eight-legged steed. Born when Loki transformed into a mare to distract the giant's stallion Svadilfari. Sleipnir can travel between the worlds, fastest of all horses.

Abilities: Can ride through all Nine Realms

The monstrous hound that guards the gates of Helheim. Bound in the cave Gnipahellir, Garmr will break free at Ragnarok. His howl signals the beginning of the final battle.

The powerful stallion belonging to the giant who built Asgard's walls. Loki transformed into a mare to lure Svadilfari away, preventing the giant from completing his work. From their union, Sleipnir was born.

The dragon that gnaws at the roots of Yggdrasil from beneath. Nidhogg eternally feeds on corpses in Niflheim and exchanges insults with the eagle atop the World Tree through the squirrel Ratatosk.

sections.title: Legendary Beasts of the Nine Realms
sections.content: The Norse cosmos teems with legendary creatures - from the monstrous children of Loki destined to bring about Ragnarok, to divine steeds and guardian beasts.

sections.title: Children of Loki - The Doom Bringers
sections.content:
The Great Wolf

The monstrous wolf, son of Loki and the giantess Angrboda. Fenrir grew so large and fearsome that the gods bound him with the magical chain Gleipnir, but he will break free at Ragnarok and devour Odin himself.

Destiny: Will kill Odin at Ragnarok

The World Serpent

The Midgard Serpent, another child of Loki. Odin threw Jormungandr into the ocean where the serpent grew so large it encircles the entire world and grasps its own tail.

Destiny: Will fight Thor at Ragnarok

The Eight-Legged Horse

Odin's magnificent eight-legged steed. Born when Loki transformed into a mare to distract the giant's stallion Svadilfari. Sleipnir can travel between the worlds, fastest of all horses.

Abilities: Can ride through all Nine Realms

sections.title: Guardian Beasts & Other Creatures
sections.content:
The Hellhound

The monstrous hound that guards the gates of Helheim. Bound in the cave Gnipahellir, Garmr will break free at Ragnarok. His howl signals the beginning of the final battle.

Destiny: Will fight Tyr at Ragnarok

The Master Builder's Stallion

The powerful stallion belonging to the giant who built Asgard's walls. Loki transformed into a mare to lure Svadilfari away, preventing the giant from completing his work. From their union, Sleipnir was born.

Legacy: Father of Sleipnir

The Corpse-Eating Dragon

The dragon that gnaws at the roots of Yggdrasil from beneath. Nidhogg eternally feeds on corpses in Niflheim and exchanges insults with the eagle atop the World Tree through the squirrel Ratatosk.
